source: Brave & Boundless, master manuscript 2026-10-19, Boundless Rule Cards pp. 273-277

rules.title: Move Before You’re Ready
rules.why_it_matters: Ready is a stall word. Motion creates proof.

drills.five_minute: Write the smallest visible step you can take in 5 minutes. Do it now.
drills.uncomfortable: Send one message that commits you publicly to a start date.
drills.daily: “MVP the day” — ship one imperfect deliverable before noon.

rules.title: Tell the Brutal Truth Fast

drills.five_minute: Draft the honest sentence you’re dodging. Read it out loud.
drills.uncomfortable: Deliver it to the person, same day, with ownership + ask.
drills.daily: Clear one micro-truth (status, budget, boundary) before lunch.

rules.scorecard: # of hard truths delivered within 24 hours.

drills.five_minute: Choose one rep that burns (cold outreach, sprint, cold shower). Do 1.
drills.uncomfortable: Schedule a weekly “hard session” with a measurable failure point.
drills.daily: Add +1 rep or +1% intensity to a core skill.

drills.five_minute: Identify today’s one “game play” (conversation, pitch, set). Prep 3 bullets.
drills.uncomfortable: Volunteer to go first in a real-stakes moment this week.
drills.daily: Post-game yourself: 3 wins, 1 fix, 1 next rep.

rules.title: Optimize the Machine
rules.why_it_matters: Body is throughput. Throughput is life.

drills.uncomfortable: Remove one indulgence for 7 days (alcohol, late scroll, sugar).
drills.daily: Sleep window alarm — consistent lights-out and wake.

rules.scorecard: Days you hit movement + protein target + sleep window.

rules.title: Freedom Requires Ownership

drills.five_minute: Ship one proof-of-value artifact (before/after, demo, micro-case).
drills.uncomfortable: Pitch with a “here’s what I already did for you” sample.
drills.daily: Create one reusable asset (template, checklist, Loom).

rules.scorecard: New assets created / week; inbound yes’s from proof.
rules.mantra: Build the table. Don’t beg for a seat.

rules.title: Pain Is Tuition; Don’t Drop Out

drills.five_minute: Name the lesson inside today’s irritation; write one sentence.
drills.uncomfortable: Re-attempt something you failed at last month with one change.

rules.scorecard: Tuition logs this week; re-attempts executed.

rules.title: Alignment Over Approval

drills.five_minute: Write your non-negotiables (3). Check today’s biggest decision against them.
drills.uncomfortable: Decline one misaligned invite/opportunity — politely, clearly.
drills.daily: One choice that favors values over vibes.

rules.mantra: Be judged for your truth, not loved for your costume.

rules.title: Faith Moves Mountains, Doubt Moves Nothing

drills.five_minute: Quiet sit: breathe 30x; speak a 10-word prayer/affirmation of purpose.
drills.uncomfortable: Share one faith/values boundary in a real setting this week.
drills.daily: Gratitude proof — record one instance of provision/answered effort.

rules.scorecard: Days with sit + entry; boundaries upheld.

rules.title: Passion Compounds Into Prosperity
rules.why_it_matters: When you love the work, you outlast everyone who’s just chasing paychecks.

drills.five_minute: Draw three circles: “Good At,” “Care About,” “People Pay For.” Find the overlap.
drills.uncomfortable: Start one side project this week in work you’d do for free. Create something. Ship it.
drills.daily: Feed the obsession: read, create, or connect with someone in that space.

rules.scorecard: Hours on passionate work vs. work you tolerate; Monday morning energy (1-10).
rules.mantra: Love the work long enough. Wealth follows.

rules.title: Build With Aligned Partners

drills.five_minute: Write your teammate filter: mission, standards, speed, communication.
drills.uncomfortable: Fire one obligation relationship; replace with an aligned ask.
drills.daily: Give one piece of no-nonsense, kind feedback to a teammate.

rules.scorecard: # adds via filter; # misaligned ties cut.

rules.title: Humble and Kind — The Ultimate Rebellion
rules.why_it_matters: Strength without humility cracks; with it, compounds.

drills.five_minute: Send a 3-line thank-you with a specific receipt (what, when, effect).
drills.uncomfortable: Apologize once this week without qualification.
drills.daily: “Hold the door” practice — spot and solve one micro-friction for someone.

rules.scorecard: Thank-yous sent; clean apologies; frictions removed.

rules.title: Love Big. Set Standards High.
rules.why_it_matters: Love without standards is neglect; standards without love is tyranny.

drills.five_minute: Write the current family/relationship standard in one sentence.
drills.uncomfortable: Enforce one boundary calmly, immediately, and consistently.

rules.scorecard: Boundaries upheld / attempted; positive reps logged.

rules.title: Raise the Standard, Earn Your Confidence

drills.five_minute: Choose one standard; attach a 3-step micro-system (trigger > action > track).
drills.uncomfortable: Audit your top process; cut one lazy shortcut permanently.
drills.daily: Run the checklist before the work, not after.

rules.scorecard: System runs completed / misses; defect rate trend.

rules.title: Make Your Life a Public Service Announcement

drills.five_minute: Name your “Carsons” (3 young people watching you).
drills.uncomfortable: Initiate one real conversation this week: future, standards, choices.
drills.daily: Do one thing hard because someone is watching.

rules.scorecard: Mentor touches; public standards moments; hard example set.
